mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sekai_learning_creations WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM sekai_learning_creations WHERE status = 'published' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sekai_learning_creations (user_id, title, content, cover_url, creation_type, tags_json, likes_count, comments_count, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{coverUrl}, #{creationType}, #{tagsJson}, #{likesCount}, #{commentsCount}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE sekai_learning_creations SET likes_count = likes_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sekai_learning_creations SET likes_count = GREATEST(likes_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sekai_learning_creations SET comments_count = comments_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
